title: Pilih dunia visual untuk landing page Shiori
question: Dice memilih Perpustakaan Sekolah. Pilih, ambil alternatif, atau re-roll.

options.label: Perpustakaan Sekolah
options.lineage: Indonesian school library card catalog system
options.thesis: Shiori's landing page is a library catalog room — the teacher walks in, scans the spine labels by jenjang, pulls a card, and the order writes itself.
options.viewport: Full-width warm library interior ground. A horizontal catalog drawer rail spans the hero, each drawer labeled by jenjang in stamped tape. The mascot sits atop the catalog like a bookmark left in a reference book. Headline in a warm display face: 'Pesan Buku Lebih Mudah' set as a catalog title card. Stats stamped below like due-date returns.
options.risk: Reads institutional rather than inviting if the wood warmth stays cold.

raised.raise: Color accent confined to thin edge bands on catalog cards, not flooding the drawer faces.
Honest small counters as chrome — book counts tick like a library's circulation counter.
Fixed grid pitch — jenjang cards snap to catalog drawer spacing, nothing floats between positions.
Primary CTA gets deliberate spatial isolation — 'Mulai Memesan' sits alone with breathing room.

options.label: Toko Buku (Bookshop Counter)
options.thesis: The landing page is a bookshop counter — stacked spines behind glass, a handwritten order slip waiting, the shopkeeper's calculator already on.
options.viewport: Warm wood-grain counter surface. Stacked book spines rise behind it as a navigable wall of jenjang categories. The mascot sits on the counter with a bookmark in hand. Headline as hand-painted shop signage: 'Pesan Buku Lebih Mudah.' An order slip form sits ready.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs for a book-ordering product would land on — the bookshop is the obvious metaphor.

options.label: Ikebana Ma Arrangement
options.thesis: Shiori as an ikebana arrangement — each jenjang is a stem placed with intention, the empty space between them is active, and the 栞 brand's Japanese soul leads.
options.viewport: Pale plaster ground with an off-center vertical composition. The mascot as the bronze suiban base. Jenjang categories as asymmetrically placed stems rising from it. Headline set vertically in a Japanese-informed display face.
options.case: Holds audience identification through the 栞 Japanese connection; loses product clarity because the arrangement metaphor doesn't carry the ordering task.
options.risk: Beautiful but obscure — teachers may not understand this is a book ordering tool.

options.label: Toyism Collective Plate
options.lineage: Hard-edged collective painting with shared symbol set
options.thesis: Each jenjang owns a bold geometric symbol in a fixed collective palette — SD is a red circle, SMP a blue triangle, SMA a yellow square — and the landing page is the collective's gallery wall.
options.viewport: Flat cream ground with bold geometric jenjang symbols hovering at different scales. The mascot as the collective's signature mark. Headline in a compact geometric sans. Symbols hover-drift on interaction.
options.case: Holds product clarity — symbols per jenjang are immediately distinct and navigable; loses audience identification — art-collective aesthetic is unfamiliar to Indonesian teachers.
options.risk: Reads as a children's art project or toy brand rather than a professional ordering tool.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.case: Loses both axes: teachers don't relate to atmospheric optics, and the metaphor doesn't carry ordering.
options.kept: Color-band discipline — accent color confined to thin edges.

options.label: Cyworld Minihompy Room
options.case: Loses both: Korean social media culture is foreign, decoration metaphor conflicts with ordering.
options.kept: Honest counters and small chrome details — ticking numbers as quiet status.

options.label: Film Cutting Bench Rail
options.lineage: Film editing bench with perforated select rail
options.case: Loses both: film editing is foreign to the audience, rail metaphor obscures catalog navigation.
options.kept: Frame-pitch discipline — items snap to a fixed grid, nothing floats.

options.label: Dark Developer Console
options.case: Loses both: teachers are not developers, console metaphor is entirely foreign.
options.kept: Spatial isolation of primary CTA — deliberate breathing room.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The SaaS landing page everyone ships: white ground, blue accent, product hero, feature grid. Executed impeccably for Shiori.
canonCard.viewport: White ground, centered headline, mascot beside a product demo, feature cards below, jenjang grid, footer. The arrangement every visitor expects.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other ordering tool by design.
